````text
# #2125: Patch: menu screens show their last data at once and refresh it in the background
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of #2036. This is a patch of its own: it goes live when it merges and builds on `main` beside the tracker's other parts.

Blocked by #2115: both change each menu screen's loading branch.

## What

This is the "stale-while-revalidate" tip. There is no cache today, so every visit to the collection, shop, wallet, ladder, stats, decks list or friends list fetches again behind a loading state. Add a small read cache in `apps/web/src/net/`, in memory only and with no new dependency, for the `GET`s those screens make.

- **Reads.** Entries are keyed by path (query included) and account. A screen with a cached answer renders it at once and fetches again in the background, and the new answer replaces it when it lands. If the background read fails, the cached answer stays and nothing is shown; a screen's error UI is only for a first visit.
- **Clearing.** The cache is cleared on sign-out and on account switch.
- **Writes.** A mutating answer that carries a new value updates its entry, so a revisit never shows the old value first. That covers a buy's wallet and counts, a pack opening's counts, a deck save or delete, and a friend added or removed.
- **Never cached:** anything a match, a duos room, a watch or a replay reads, and anything that isn't a `GET`.
- **First visit.** A screen with nothing cached shows its skeleton (#2115).

## Done when

vitest checks that:
- a cache hit renders without the loading state, then takes the background answer;
- sign-out empties the cache, and an account switch never shows the other account's data;
- a buy's answer updates the cached wallet;
- a failed background read keeps the cached data;
- match, duos, watch and replay reads never touch the cache.

import { tokenClaim } from "../auth/claims.ts";

/** The most answers kept; the one kept longest ago goes first (each statistics filter keeps its own). */
export const READ_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 64;

/** The account of a public read. */
const PUBLIC = "";

/** The account whose answers are kept, or null. */
let owner: string | null = null;
const entries = new Map<string, unknown>();

function accountOf(token: string | null): string {
  return token === null ? PUBLIC : (tokenClaim(token, "sub") ?? token);
}

/** The answer `token`'s account (null: a public read) last had for `path`, or undefined. */
export function cachedRead<T>(token: string | null, path: string): T | undefined {
  const account = accountOf(token);
  if (account !== PUBLIC && account !== owner) return undefined;
  return entries.get(`${account}\n${path}`) as T | undefined;
}

/** Keeps `value` as that account's answer for `path`; another account's answers go first. */
export function rememberRead(token: string | null, path: string, value: unknown): void {
  const account = accountOf(token);
  if (account !== PUBLIC && account !== owner) {
    entries.clear();
    owner = account;
  }
  const key = `${account}\n${path}`;
  entries.delete(key);
  entries.set(key, value);
  if (entries.size > READ_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES) {
    const oldest = entries.keys().next().value;
    if (oldest !== undefined) entries.delete(oldest);
  }
}

/** Folds a write's answer into the kept answer for `path`; nothing when none is kept. */
export function updateCachedRead<T>(token: string | null, path: string, update: (before: T) => T): void {
  const before = cachedRead<T>(token, path);
  if (before !== undefined) rememberRead(token, path, update(before));
}

/** Sign-out (`net/session.ts`) and every test (`test/setup.ts`). */
export function clearReadCache(): void {
  entries.clear();
  owner = null;
}

/** Test support: how many answers are kept. */
export function __readCacheSizeForTests(): number {
  return entries.size;
}
```
````

```ts
/** The most answers kept; the one kept longest ago goes first (each statistics filter keeps its own). */
export const READ_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 64;

/** The account of a public read. */
const PUBLIC = "";

/** The account whose answers are kept, or null. */
let owner: string | null = null;
const entries = new Map<string, unknown>();

function accountOf(token: string | null): string {

/** The answer `token`'s account (null: a public read) last had for `path`, or undefined. */
export function cachedRead<T>(token: string | null, path: string): T | undefined {
  const account = accountOf(token);
  if (account !== PUBLIC && account !== owner) return undefined;
  return entries.get(`${account}\n${path}`) as T | undefined;
}

/** Keeps `value` as that account's answer for `path`; another account's answers go first. */
export function rememberRead(token: string | null, path: string, value: unknown): void {
  const account = accountOf(token);
  if (account !== PUBLIC && account !== owner) {
    entries.clear();
    owner = account;
  }
  const key = `${account}\n${path}`;
  entries.delete(key);
  entries.set(key, value);
  if (entries.size > READ_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES) {
    const oldest = entries.keys().next().value;
    if (oldest !== undefined) entries.delete(oldest);
  }
}

/** Folds a write's answer into the kept answer for `path`; nothing when none is kept. */
export function updateCachedRead<T>(token: string | null, path: string, update: (before: T) => T): void {
  const before = cachedRead<T>(token, path);
  if (before !== undefined) rememberRead(token, path, update(before));
}

/** Sign-out (`net/session.ts`) and every test (`test/setup.ts`). */
export function clearReadCache(): void {
  entries.clear();
  owner = null;
}

/** Test support: how many answers are kept. */
export function __readCacheSizeForTests(): number {
  return entries.size;
}
```

```ts
const entries = new Map<string, unknown>();

function accountOf(token: string | null): string {
  return token === null ? PUBLIC : (tokenClaim(token, "sub") ?? token);
}

/** The answer `token`'s account (null: a public read) last had for `path`, or undefined. */
export function cachedRead<T>(token: string | null, path: string): T | undefined {
  const account = accountOf(token);
  if (account !== PUBLIC && account !== owner) return undefined;
  return entries.get(`${account}\n${path}`) as T | undefined;
}

/** Keeps `value` as that account's answer for `path`; another account's answers go first. */
export function rememberRead(token: string | null, path: string, value: unknown): void {
  const account = accountOf(token);
  if (account !== PUBLIC && account !== owner) {
    entries.clear();
    owner = account;
  }
  const key = `${account}\n${path}`;
  entries.delete(key);
  entries.set(key, value);
  if (entries.size > READ_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES) {
    const oldest = entries.keys().next().value;
    if (oldest !== undefined) entries.delete(oldest);
  }
}

/** Folds a write's answer into the kept answer for `path`; nothing when none is kept. */
export function updateCachedRead<T>(token: string | null, path: string, update: (before: T) => T): void {
  const before = cachedRead<T>(token, path);
  if (before !== undefined) rememberRead(token, path, update(before));
}

/** Sign-out (`net/session.ts`) and every test (`test/setup.ts`). */
export function clearReadCache(): void {
  entries.clear();
  owner = null;
}

/** Test support: how many answers are kept. */
export function __readCacheSizeForTests(): number {
  return entries.size;
}
```
